//: Cruise-control end-to-end demo on the electronics-driven path.
//1: ev1sim drives Chrono entirely from electronics output:
//2: scenario set_throttle → main bus 6903 → PIM → chassis bus 4073
//4: Cruise authority lives in PIM (pim_throttle_cmd_q8 / pim_supervisor).
//13: Cruise gating (per pim_supervisor): vehicle must be ≥ 25 mph
//14: (11.176 m/s) before SET engages, brake released, PRND in D.
//15: wait_for_speed blocks the SET event until that threshold is met.
//17: Without PIM running, ApplyElectronicsThrottle falls back to the
//18: local pedal — set_throttle then drives Chrono directly.  Cruise
//19: events become no-ops (no PIM to receive them).  The scenario still
//20: completes, but the assert_speed_within at t=35 will likely fail
name: cruise_demo_electronics

events.//: Floor it from a stop until we're well past the cruise threshold.
Wait until speed exceeds 13 m/s (~29 mph), comfortably above the 25 mph cruise gate.
Release the pedal + engage cruise as soon as we're up to speed.
After 15 s of cruise hold, assert speed is still close to setpoint.
Bump cruise +1 mph, hold for a while, assert again.
